prior_exposure: workbook string labels and GEO sample metadata; no new numerical outcomes inspected
contract.scope: Noninfectious differentiation and input-response comparisons only
contract.biological_question: Does reducing a growth-maintenance input release mature alveolar differentiation, or redirect/lose alveolar identity depending on starting context?

qpcr.unit: explicit source donor-coded line; fig6a described as independent pool organoid cultures; no independent population origin interaction
qpcr.outcome: negative DeltaCt; change = reference DeltaCt minus comparison DeltaCt; log2 expression ratio assuming equal PCR efficiency
qpcr.pairing: exact matching donor IDs within sheet/gene; retain mismatches and undetected values in audit; no imputation
qpcr.estimation: per-line paired change, mean, median, range; two-sided t interval when n>=2, descriptive under independence/normality; no discovery p-values
qpcr.TCF4: retain source-assay name; not equated to modern TCF7L2 without assay verification

bulk.selection: only eight uninfected bulk alveolar-organoid libraries with titles matching ctrl|GSK3kd crossed with ctrl|CHIR and blocks1/2
bulk.unit: two source blocks; paper reports two donor cultures, block and hairpin confounded; no population inference
bulk.filter: count>=10 in at least2 of8 libraries
bulk.normalization: TMM with edgeR, log2(CPM+1); total-count CPM sensitivity; do not pool with Nb2 matrices
contrasts: CHIR absent minus present within control background/block
CHIR absent minus present within GSK3KD background/block
difference between those withdrawal responses per block
bulk.interpretation: supporting RNA phenotypes, not lineage/function, direct Wnt activity, or Fzd schedule effects
